BRIEFING / HOTWIRE

One minute. One shot.

One timer. Three stages. Hit the pink zone 3 times, repeat 4 signals, then dodge traffic and reach the hideout.

  • Space — pick the lock.
  • Keys 1–4 — ignition panel.
  • A / D or arrow keys — switch lanes.
  • Hold Shift or the NITRO button to boost. Nitro recharges when released.
  • Close passes build a style combo. Crashes break it.
  • P — pause. Use the sound button to toggle audio.

On mobile, use the on-screen controls. A lightweight chase mode is available if 3D is not supported.
